title: Fit for the Job? An OSPE as quality assessment for practical education of practical year medical students in anaesthesiology
summary: The aim is to develop, implement and validate OSPEs that can assess the quality of practical training for students in their practical year (PJ students) in anaesthesia. OSPE stands for ‘objective structured practical examination’.
conditions: Quality of training for medical students in their practical year

interventions.name: PJ students complete a digital logbook each week during the elective period, which asks about key anaesthesia activities.
